title: Nanobioparticle-prepared biochar enhanced Fenton oxidation for treatment of saline organic wastewater
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,618-626
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00760C, Paper
Shanhong Lan, Shiwen Geng, Yuqi Jin, Hui Zhang, Xun Liu, Chenbo Ma, Chuankun Li, Xuejie Dong, Qiliang Cao, Ke Li
This research enhances Fenton oxidation for saline organic wastewater by incorporating FeS nano-biological particles, which optimizes redox potential and the use of H2O2 to enhance COD removal.
